item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Monitor Health Models
item.description:
Azure Monitor Health Models is now generally available. The feature lets you define workload health as a first-class construct by aggregating metrics, logs, and dependency signals into a single model.

  • Source: Azure Updates
